name: SupplyChain Scan — API on RapidAPI
description:
Scan a list of npm dependencies for known vulnerabilities in one call: SupplyChain Scan checks every package against the OSV database and npm registry data and returns a severity-ranked fix list, so dependency audits stop being a manual one-by-one chore.

What you get:
- Per-package vulnerability findings matched against OSV records, with severity ratings
- Package health context from npm (latest version, deprecation status)
- A ranked remediation list for the whole batch, plus a summary you can attach to a security review
- Honest scope: a clean result means OSV currently has no record for that package and version — it is not a guarantee of safety

Key endpoints:
- POST /scan — scan up to 100 dependencies in one call
- GET /health — service status

Plans: BASIC is free with 200 calls per month. PRO is $9/month for 10,000 calls. ULTRA is $29/month for 50,000 calls plus $0.001 per additional call.

Access: subscribe on RapidAPI (free tier available); calls are made over HTTPS with your RapidAPI key.
